examples.trans: Hair must not get into the food!

examples.text: Как этот волос попал в тарелку?

examples.trans: There are five stages of accepting the inevitable.

meanings.en: to rest, relax, be on holiday

examples.trans: Everything is great, get some rest!

examples.trans: Everything is great, get some rest! It is the weekend today, everything is cool!

отломиться.gloss: to break off; (colloq.) to come one's way

meanings.en: (colloq., кому) to come one's way, to get lucky
meanings.note: тебе отломится = you'll get something out of it

examples.trans: Something is bound to come your way tonight.
A leg broke off the chair.

examples.text: Пойду сяду за столик для плебеев.

examples.text: Люди в городе аплодируют вашей победе!

подставить.gloss: to set up, frame; to put under

meanings.note: подставить плечо: to lend a shoulder

examples.trans: I swear, they simply framed me.
